dependencies_and_execution_gate.execution_state: NOT_AUTHORIZED_BY_THIS_CONTRACT; report this contract and dependencies before any worker run.
dependencies_and_execution_gate.existing_data_path: V5 bound manifest/resolved/612-mode manifest/auxiliary/VTU -> DG6 -> N1E6 -> zero_slave_storage; no new input or production route.
dependencies_and_execution_gate.future_fresh_contract_if_executed: Reuse the existing Task40 action-only supervisor/host-floor/shared-lock/CPU9+24/MPI1/math1/NUMA interleave0-1/PSS-off/swap-observe contract; no new RSS cap or retry policy.

truncation_path.historical_per_row_cutoff_statistics: NOT_RECORDED; deleted counts, deleted-row dot contributions, and cutoff maxima must be measured in the new diagnostic; do not infer them from prior summaries.
truncation_path.in_memory_cache: The builder uses a phase-keyed component_cache and the reused-vector workspace. This is in-memory reuse, not a disk functional store.
truncation_path.projection_conjugation: Combined projection values are conjugated when stored in FullspaceDtnModeFunctional; FullspaceDtnAction then computes np.dot(projection_values, source_values). Preserve this order exactly.
truncation_path.stage_1: Each x/y component PETSc vector is MPC-assembled, then _vec_nonzero_owned_entries retains entries with abs(value) > max(1e-30, 1e-13 * global_max_on_owned_support).
truncation_path.stage_2: _combine_owned_entries applies the coefficients, stable-sorts and sums duplicate rows, then independently retains abs(summed_value) > max(1e-30, 1e-13 * global_max_after_merge). Projection and coupling each use this merge cutoff.

interpretation_limits.MPC_conjugation_recovery_alternatives: Remain open; separate component cutoff, merged cutoff, MPC-dual vs direct full-primal, projection conjugation, mode normalization, saved-field reconstruction, and auxiliary recovery without presupposing any is causal.
interpretation_limits.v4_v5_status_remains: NO_CARRIER_COMPARISON; prior failures remain immutable and this capture grants no qualification.

cancellation_and_cutoff_deltas: deleted-dot complex contribution at both stages
absolute and relative values with denominator/source explicitly recorded
coupling_stages: Record the same raw/component-cut/merged-cut accounting separately for coefficients (-traction_x,-traction_y): row/max/cutoff/deletion statistics and complex dot of each stage against the same zero-slave field. Do not call this projection N or saved auxiliary amplitude.

cutoff_integrity.closure: Both component-removal and merged-removal numerator deltas close against deleted-dot sums.
cutoff_integrity.cutoff_terms: Each stage records floor, relative term, actual cutoff and dominant term.
cutoff_integrity.stage_1: Actual production _vec_nonzero_owned_entries per x/y component; exact rows/values comparison; bounded raw samples and hash before workspace reuse.
cutoff_integrity.stage_2: Actual production _combine_owned_entries for projection/coupling; exact rows/values comparison.

facts: x/y raw component maxima and exact nonzero row counts before stage-1 cutoff
raw projection numerator N after the exact mode.e_vector coefficients and production conjugation order
per-component global max, support size, cutoff, removed-row count, maximum removed magnitude
per-component deleted-dot contribution against the same zero-slave field
merged global max, cutoff, unique rows before/after, removed-row count and maximum removed magnitude
stage-2 deleted-dot contribution against the same field

reconstruction_and_field_binding: Hash/finite-check DG6, reconstructed N1E6, zero-slave storage and same-storage MPC-expanded primal.
Record DG6 -> N1E6 -> DG6 reconstruction and zero-slave -> MPC-backsubstitution expansion errors.
Independent q28 integrals for saved DG6, reconstructed N1E6, zero-slave-only diagnostic and MPC-backsubstituted full-primal field from the exact same storage.
saved_auxiliary_comparison: bind exact auxiliary row by parent index and signed key
record H, boundary phase P, total saved auxiliary, saved outgoing boundary amplitude, and incident term separately
compare top 00 to saved total auxiliary projection; retain outgoing-only as a separate diagnostic field

prior_evidence.V4_and_V5_gate_state: Both Y2 and Y3 remain NO_CARRIER_COMPARISON due the unaveraged facet trace relative gate; this contract does not alter that state.

observed_total_auxiliary_boundary_differ.note: For top (0,0,s), compare against saved total auxiliary projection, not the outgoing-only boundary amplitude.

question: Can the two existing 1e-13 component/merged sparse-entry cutoffs explain the saved auxiliary projection discrepancy for the six exact signed Y2/Y3 keys when applied to the same reconstructed zero-slave field?

scope.field: Use the same V5 VTU-derived DG6 -> N1E6 reconstruction copied to zero-slave storage for all cutoff dots. Independent full-primal integration uses the MPC-backsubstitution-expanded field restored from that same storage; original DG6 and reconstructed N1E6 remain separate references. Zero-slave-only integration is not called full primal.
scope.mesh_reuse: Rebuild each historical mesh/space/MPC from its bound resolved input; no cross-grid FE object reuse.

runtime_integrity_contract.MPC_and_vector_lifecycle: Preserve reverse-add then forward-insert ghost updates; record owned ranges/ghosts; do not clear/write input or production field vectors.
runtime_integrity_contract.closure: Pre/post numerator delta must close against deleted-dot within bounded floating reduction error; otherwise DIAGNOSTIC_IMPLEMENTATION_FAILURE, not cutoff evidence.
runtime_integrity_contract.coupling_dot: Preserve production non-conjugated dot; algebraic coupling, not physical power.
runtime_integrity_contract.production_cutoff_calls: Call actual production component and merged helpers and compare returned rows/values elementwise.
runtime_integrity_contract.projection_conjugation: Conjugate merged production projection values before np.dot with same zero-slave storage.
runtime_integrity_contract.raw_component_snapshot: Copy only owned structural support before workspace reuse.
runtime_integrity_contract.stage_accounting: Each component and merged stage reports maximum, absolute floor, relative term, actual cutoff, dominant term, deleted rows/max and complex deleted-dot.
runtime_integrity_contract.top00: Compare saved total auxiliary projection; incident and outgoing remain separate.
